definitionSource: English documentation statements in the SUMO KIF source files
definitionPolicy: Use project editorial definitions for the canonical upper ontology and retain SUMO or graft definitions for physical descendants

canonicalOverlay.policy: Replace the SUMO upper ontology with Entity, Property, and Relation; retain the SUMO-derived physical projection

organismGraft.source: Human Knowledge 2000 taxonomy table + modern Wikipedia clade corrections
organismGraft.policy: Monophyletic, interest-weighted backbone; specialist-only subdivisions telescoped
organismGraft.originEstimatePolicy: Every grafted clade definition begins with an integer Mya origin estimate

primaryEdgeRule: Repeatedly remove the longest measured incoming PDF arc until each node has one primary parent; apply four explicitly marked provisional placements to keep Entity as the only root
